My understanding is Pelosi was initially a strong supporter of a public option, and is considered to have been instrumental in getting the ACA passed. Is that wrong?


Aaron Regunberg (@AaronRegunberg)

I hate to pile on cause she’s had a rough go of it but genuinely anyone who earnestly thinks that Nancy Pelosi would have passed single payer if she had her way doesn’t have enough of a basic understanding of the world to have any business being a political commentator.
